_comment: Machine-enforced rules only. The human context lives in profile.md.
_browser_app_note: Exact macOS app name. Jarvis talks to it only if it is ALREADY running - it never launches a browser. Run `read_tabs.py --which` to see what's open. Also valid: Google Chrome Beta, Google Chrome Canary, Chromium, Brave Browser, Microsoft Edge, Arc, Vivaldi.
_protect_note: Substring match on the URL. These are never closed, whatever the agent concludes. Add your mail, calendar, chat, and anything you keep open as a matter of habit - e.g. "mail.google.com", "app.slack.com", "github.com/pulls". Unsaved-state tabs are also protected, but by judgment rather than pattern.
_autonomous_note: true: reading tabs are filed and closed without asking. false: Jarvis lists what it would close and waits for you. Nothing is ever lost either way - every tab is written to jarvis.json before it is closed.
_port_note: Local dashboard port, bound to 127.0.0.1 only. Change it if something else owns 7777.

knowledge._github_note: Optional. A knowledge-base repo URL, e.g. https://github.com/you/notes - Jarvis reads its README to learn your vocabulary.
knowledge._folders_note: Optional. Absolute paths Jarvis may skim to learn your project vocabulary, e.g. ["/Users/you/notes", "/Users/you/work/docs"]. It reads titles and READMEs, not whole files.
